title: 06 · A judgement call inside a SQL query

nodes.head: your query
nodes.text:
SELECT jev_topic(text),
       count(*)
FROM reviews
WHERE jev_is_bug(text) > 0.8
GROUP BY 1

nodes.head: Jev
nodes.text: answers the whole column at once

notes.text:
Row by row, a thousand rows would take several minutes.
Column at a time, with forty calls in flight, it takes about ten seconds.

nodes.head: before
nodes.text:
export to CSV
write a script
wait
load the results back
and it joins, groups and filters like any other column

notes.text: The analyst never leaves SQL. That is the part that changes who can use this.

nodes.text: every row is a network call
so cache by text, and scan what you need
the same query twice costs once
put the cheap filters first in the WHERE

notes.text: A model in a query is still a model. Treat it like an expensive column, not a free one.
